label: Age
description: Student age at the time of the survey.

label: Grade level
description: Current school grade, including nontraditional grade classifications.

label: Race
description: Self-identified race and ethnicity, including Hispanic or Latino identity, multiple identities, and detailed subgroup responses.

label: Gender
description: Self-reported gender identity or sex as asked in each survey version.

label: Transgender identity
description: Self-reported gender identity as transgender or nonbinary identities.

label: Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual identity
description: Self-described sexual orientation as gay, lesbian, bisexual, and questioning responses.

label: Immigration background
description: Place of birth and time living in the United States or California.

label: Language spoken at home
description: Languages spoken at home and self-reported English proficiency or English learner program participation.

label: Parental education level
description: Highest level of education completed by parents or guardians.

label: Military family connection
description: Family military service, deployment, and students' experiences of military-related family demands and support.

label: Housing/living arrangements: Homeless
description: Where students live, or experiences of unstable or temporary housing.

label: Housing/living arrangements: Foster Care
description: Where students live, or experiences of living in foster care.

label: Economic disadvantage
description: Indicators of financial disadvantage, including eligibility for free or reduced-price school meals.

label: Enrollment in special education
description: Individualized education plans and participation in special education services.

label: Academic performance
description: Self-reported school grades and academic achievement.

label: Skipping school
description: Absences, skipped classes, and reasons for missing school, including health, safety, and family responsibilities.

label: Academic engagement
description: Interest in learning, motivation, attention, effort, homework habits, and perceived value of school.

label: Educational and career aspirations
description: Goals and expectations for finishing school, attending college, and pursuing a career.

label: School connectedness
description: Belonging, closeness, acceptance, and feeling valued as a member of the school community.

label: Support from teacher or adult at school
description: Caring relationships, encouragement, and emotional support from teachers and other adults at school.

label: Student voice and participation in school activities
description: Opportunities to contribute to school activities, classroom discussions, decisions, and school improvement.

label: School relationships and respect
description: How students and staff treat one another, including respect, cooperation, and the quality of peer relationships.

label: School rules and discipline
description: Clarity, fairness, strictness, and enforcement of school rules, including suspension and exclusionary discipline.

label: School safety
description: Students' perceived safety at school and fears of violence or injury.

label: Bullying
description: Bullying and harassment, including verbal, physical, relational, online, and identity-based experiences, and school responses to bullying.

label: School diversity and inclusion
description: Respect for differences and representation of diverse racial, cultural, and other identities in school relationships and learning materials.

label: LGBTQ support
description: School safety, affirming groups, information, and support for sexual orientation and gender identity or expression.

label: School facilities: clean vs not clean
description: Cleanliness, physical condition, drinking water, and crowding in school facilities.

label: Ate breakfast
description: Participation in school breakfast.

label: School and community services
description: Awareness of and access to practical school-based supports, referrals, emergency assistance, and community partnerships.

label: Remote learning
description: School attendance format and participation, schedules, and support for learning from home or online.

label: Afterschool activities
description: Participation, interest, access, and perceived benefits of afterschool programs, clubs, sports, arts, and other organized activities.

label: Family support
description: Care, communication, closeness, encouragement, and emotional support from parents, guardians, and family members.

label: Parental involvement
description: Parent or guardian involvement in schoolwork, school events, and students' education.

label: Family participation and responsibilities
description: Students' contributions to family decisions, household tasks, and responsibilities at home.

label: Support from peers or friends
description: Caring friendships, emotional support, and a sense of connection with peers.

label: Positive peer influence
description: Friends' expectations, prosocial behavior, and encouragement of school success and responsible choices.

label: Support from adults in community
description: Caring adults, encouragement, and supportive relationships beyond home and school.

label: Community connectedness
description: Belonging, closeness, and attachment to the neighborhood or community.

label: Community participation
description: Youth involvement in community groups, volunteering, service, and decisions that affect community life.

label: Neighborhood safety
description: Perceived safety in neighborhoods, parks, and other community settings.

label: Police relationships
description: Perceptions of fairness, safety, and conduct of police in school and community settings.

label: Relationships with adults who engage in risky behavior
description: Contact with adults who use or sell substances, belong to gangs, or have problems with the law.

label: Safety at home
description: Perceived safety in the home or current living setting.

label: Physical violence at school
description: Experiences of physical attacks, fights, threats, or witnessing violence at school or in the community.

label: Dating violence
description: Physical harm or abuse by a boyfriend, girlfriend, or dating partner.

label: Sexual violence
description: Forced sexual intercourse and other nonconsensual sexual experiences.

label: Access to weapons
description: Access to weapons and carrying, using, seeing, or being threatened with guns or other weapons.

label: Gang involvement
description: Gang membership, exposure to gangs, recruitment, and gang-related activities or harm.

label: Juvenile justice involvement
description: Theft, property damage, drug selling, and contact with police or the justice system.

label: Gambling
description: Participation in betting or gambling, including the types and frequency of gambling activities.

label: Depressive symptoms
description: Self-reported sadness, hopelessness, loss of interest, and related depressive symptoms.

label: Feeling Hopeless
description: Self-reported hopelessness.

label: Anxiety
description: Worry, nervousness, panic, fear, tension, and difficulty relaxing.

label: other psychological distress
description: Broader emotional distress, irritability, agitation, and difficulty coping, including existing distress scales.

label: Trauma-related symptoms
description: Existing trauma-related symptom scales and profiles, including difficulties with attention, mood, sleep, and social connection.

label: Suicidal ideation
description: Thoughts about suicide, suicide planning, and suicide attempts.

label: Self-harm
description: Intentional self-injury reported separately from questions about suicide attempts.

label: Loneliness
description: Feeling alone, isolated, or disconnected from other people.

label: Life satisfaction
description: Satisfaction with life overall and with oneself, family, friendships, school, and living circumstances.

label: Positive emotional wellbeing
description: Happiness, energy, enthusiasm, pride, and enjoyment of life.

label: Optimism
description: Positive expectations about daily experiences and the future.

label: Gratitude
description: Feelings of thankfulness, gratitude, and appreciation.

label: Self-efficacy
description: Confidence in one's abilities and capacity to succeed or handle challenges.

label: Self-awareness and purpose
description: Understanding one's feelings, motives, strengths, and sense of purpose.

label: Emotion regulation
description: Ability to manage emotions, calm oneself, and recover from upsetting experiences.

label: Empathy
description: Understanding other people's perspectives and responding to their feelings with care.

label: Availability of mental health support
description: Awareness, availability, use, and perceived helpfulness of mental health support from adults, peers, counselors, or therapists.

label: Sleep
description: Sleep duration, bedtime and waking schedules, and reported sleep difficulties.

label: General physical health
description: Self-rated health and reported ongoing physical health conditions.

label: Body aches and pain
description: Reported bodily symptoms such as headaches, stomachaches, pain, dizziness, weakness, or a racing heart.

label: Asthma and respiratory symptoms
description: Asthma history, breathing symptoms, attacks, treatment, and related health care use.

label: Access to health care
description: Usual sources of medical care, access to school health services, and preventive medical visits.

label: Access to dental care
description: Dental visits and access to dental examinations, cleaning, or treatment.

label: Level of physical activity
description: Exercise, sports participation, muscle strengthening, and activity during physical education.

label: Diet and nutrition
description: Consumption of fruits, vegetables, dairy, water, sweetened drinks, other foods, and vitamin supplements.

label: Screen time
description: Time spent watching television, playing video games, or using computers and digital media for recreation.

label: Body image
description: Perceptions of weight or body shape and efforts to change or maintain weight, including potentially harmful weight-control practices.

label: Tobacco use
description: Use of cigarettes, cigars, smokeless tobacco, and other tobacco products, including initiation and frequency.

label: Vaping use
description: Use of vaping devices or electronic cigarettes, including nicotine, cannabis, other contents, and initiation or frequency.

label: Alcohol use
description: Alcohol consumption, initiation, drinking frequency, and episodes of heavy drinking or intoxication.

label: Cannabis use
description: Use of marijuana, cannabis, THC, hashish, or related products, including initiation and frequency.

label: Other drug use
description: Use of illicit or nonmedical substances such as stimulants, hallucinogens, inhalants, heroin, steroids, or other drugs.

label: Perceived harms of substance use
description: Beliefs about health risks associated with different substances and patterns of use.

label: Level of ease to buy substances
description: Perceived ease of obtaining substances, sources and purchase locations, and offers or sales of substances to students.
